1.explanation:
• rules/no-unused-vars.md – shows the rule’s official behavior and the ignoreRestSiblings option.
• user-guide/configuring.md – describes how to configure ESLint rules and pass parser options (necessary to reproduce config).
• developer-guide/working-with-rules.md – explains how rules are structured and how they should respond to AST nodes, which helps locate where the behavior is implemented.
• developer-guide/source-code.md – points to where in the codebase the no-unused-vars rule lives and how it’s wired into ESLint.
• developer-guide/unit-tests.md – details how to write and run rule tests; you’ll need to add a test case for this scenario to reproduce and verify the fix.
• developer-guide/development-environment.md – provides instructions for setting up the exact ESLint, Node, and parser versions to replicate the bug environment.
